paper_title: Searches for signatures of ultra-light axion dark matter in polarimetry data of the European Pulsar Timing Array
notes: Paper reports constraints on axion-photon coupling g_aγ from European Pulsar Timing Array (EPTA) DR2 polarimetry data using 12 millisecond pulsars. Both frequentist (Lomb-Scargle periodogram) and Bayesian analyses performed. Best frequentist sensitivity at m_a ≈ 8×10^-24 eV yields g_aγ ≈ 5×10^-13 GeV^-1 (95% CL). Best Bayesian conservative limit at m_a ≈ 3×10^-23 eV yields g_aγ ≈ 2×10^-13 GeV^-1 (95% CL). A statistically significant signal found between 10^-8 and 2×10^-8 Hz (m_a ≈ 5×10^-23 eV) is attributed to residual Faraday rotation in terrestrial ionosphere, not ULDM. Local DM density assumed ρ_0 = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (standard Galactic value). Mass range constrained: 6×10^-24 to 5×10^-21 eV.
